description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeLicense entity class for the OrangeHRM project, representing employee licenses with annotations for ORM mapping, including properties like license details, issue and expiry dates, and relationships to Employee and License entities.

classes.name: EmployeeLicense
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee's license, including properties for license details, dates, and ORM mappings with relationships to Employee and License entities.

methods.name: getLicenseIssuedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the license was issued.

methods.name: setLicenseIssuedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the license was issued.

methods.name: getLicenseExpiryDate
methods.description: Returns the expiry date of the license.

methods.name: setLicenseExpiryDate
methods.description: Sets the expiry date of the license.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee entity associated with this license.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with this license.
